name: Great Aether Boom
description: The event that transformed Vahd's farmlands into airship industry.

timeline.summary: Plane-wide availability of aether spurs the Great Aether Boom, a time of frenzied invention.
timeline.quote: It was a time of frenzied invention, boundless hope, and wondrous celebration.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The Great Aether Boom transforms Vahd: wheat fields are cleared for runways, hangars and workshops.
timeline.quote: The Great Aether Boom transformed Vahd’s quiet farmlands almost overnight.
